title: Priority-based early-exit queue + multi-region failover dashboard and SLI instrumentation
creator: Maya Chen
description: Problem: During bursty traffic we see long tail token emission latency and cascading queue growth that triggers coarse throttles. There is no single dashboard that shows priority queue health, early-exit counts, circuit-breaker trips, and cross-region reroute activity together with token-level latency distributions. Goal: ship instrumentation and a Grafana dashboard that makes it trivial for on-call and SREs to diagnose why requests are being early-exited or shed across regions, and to correlate those events with token-level SLI regressions. Outcome: better runbook-driven response and data to tune thresholds (reduce user-facing errors, maintain latency SLOs while controlling cost).
acceptance_criteria: 1) Token-level latency histograms (per-region, per-priority) available in Prometheus/Thanos with p50/p95/p99 + heatmap panel in Grafana. 2) Early-exit and queue-shed counters exposed by priority queue and shown as time-series and stack breakdown by reason (cpu_backpressure, kv_miss, memory_threshold, scale_delay). 3) Circuit-breaker state timeline (open/closed/half-open) visible per-shard and aggregated per-region. 4) Cross-region failover events logged to events stream and visible on dashboard with links to runbook steps. 5) New Prometheus alerts created for sustained token-p99 increase, rapid growth in early-exit ratio, and repeated circuit open/close flapping. 6) Playbook updated and tested with chaos runbook for simulated region overload.
tasks: Add token-level histogram metric (llm_token_emit_latency_seconds_bucket) with labels: region, priority, model_variant, shard_id
Instrument early_exit_counter{reason, priority, region} and expose per-minute rate
Add gauge for request_queue_length{priority, region, queue_type} and queue_age_percentile metrics
Emit circuit_breaker_state{shard_id, region, policy_name} and increment circuit_opened events
Define Prometheus recording rules for per-priority p95/p99 token latency and early-exit rate
Build Grafana dashboard panels: latency heatmap, p95 trend, early-exit stacked breakdown, queue age percentiles, circuit timeline, failover events panel
Create Alertmanager rules and link to runbook; add paging thresholds for P0/P1 customers
Add deterministic sampling for full traces (1 in 100 requests) and ensure traces include token timing and queue wait spans
Docs: update runbook + design doc on Confluence; link dashboard and alerts
End-to-end test: simulate priority burst in staging and verify metrics and alerts
notes: Implementation must avoid high-cardinality explosion. Use label cardinality limits: only allow top-5 model_variant per deployment, bucket low-frequency shards into 'other'. We decided to track priority as enum {realtime, interactive, background}. Recording rules will collapse shard_id into shard_group for long-term storage.
